summary.description: One to three sentences: what the meeting was about and where it ended.

decisions.description: What the group agreed, as it finally stood. Empty when nothing was decided.

decision.description: What was agreed, in one sentence.

action_items.description: Who will do what, by when. Empty when nobody took anything on.

owner.description: The person, as the transcript names them, or 'unassigned'.

task.description: What they will do, in one sentence.

due.description: The date or deadline given, or 'not stated'.

open_questions.description: What was raised and not settled. Empty when nothing was left open.

human_summary.description: Written LAST. The minutes as a short Markdown note for the attendees: a one-line summary, then Decisions, Action items and Open questions, omitting any that are empty.
